findings.explanation: V2 fallbackActionRef 'basic-action' was not migrated into the synthesized mechanicalConflictFallbacks entry; the entry contains null instead of the required array.

V2 actionNorms priorities (60 and 40) were not preserved in the V3 actionNorms entry; the synthesized entry has priority 40 but the original 60-priority norm was retired without transferring its priority.

V2 selfAwareness fields were extracted to consciousGuidance but the V3 actionNorms schema requires no selfAwareness field; however the migration removed the field entirely rather than confirming its absence per V3 schema.

response.summary: Migration split V2 actionNorms correctly into consciousGuidance and actionNorms, but the fallbackActionRef value was lost (null instead of ["basic-action"]) and the original priority 60 was not carried into the V3 actionNorms entry.
